newsitem.title: USA: American strike could cost $200 mln/day - Dot.
newsitem.headline: American strike could cost $200 mln/day - Dot.

text.p: A strike by American Airlines Inc pilots could cost the U.S. economy between $100 and $200 million a day, a senior Department of Transportation official said Thursday.

The official, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said the DoT had prepared a report on the impact of a strike by the country's No. 2 carrier on the public and the economy and had sent it to the National Mediation Board.
"We have provided to the NMB as we always do our estimate on what the impacts on the public would be," the official said.

"A substantial number of passengers and cargo would be affected in the short run ... the impact on the economy would be in the range of $100 to $200 million a day using our stnadrad economic models," he said.
The official said a strike could affect as many as 40,000 passengers daily in the early stages of a walkout as capacity on other airlines initially would be limited.
Up to 50 tonnes of mail a day would be affected, he added.
